issue_title: Handle multiple Content-Length headers with the same value
issue_body: RFC 7230 allows a recipient to normalize duplicate Content-Length fields when every decimal value is identical. h11 currently rejects multiple Content-Length headers even when they have the same value. Accept duplicate equal values and comma-separated equal values by normalizing them to one header, but continue rejecting conflicting values.
validation_patch:
diff --git a/h11/tests/test_headers.py b/h11/tests/test_headers.py
--- a/h11/tests/test_headers.py
+++ b/h11/tests/test_headers.py
@@ -54,6 +54,18 @@
     with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
         normalize_and_validate([("Content-Length", "1"), ("Content-Length", "2")])
+    assert normalize_and_validate(
+        [("Content-Length", "0"), ("Content-Length", "0")]
+    ) == [(b"content-length", b"0")]
+    assert normalize_and_validate([("Content-Length", "0 , 0")]) == [
+        (b"content-length", b"0")
+    ]
+    with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
+        normalize_and_validate(
+            [("Content-Length", "1"), ("Content-Length", "1"), ("Content-Length", "2")]
+        )
+    with pytest.raises(LocalProtocolError):
+        normalize_and_validate([("Content-Length", "1 , 1,2")])
